summary.timing_note: SSE prompt_eval_duration and prompt_tokens_per_second include the server first-token boundary; this is not a pure GPU prefill kernel timer. Model load is reported separately. Client TTFT includes loopback request overhead.
summary.cold_start_note: The first driver request is a discarded warmup. Only claim process-cold loading if initial loaded_weight_inventory is empty and model_load_duration is reported; candidate warmup JIT costs are also retained separately in rows.
summary.comparison_note: Same compressed checkpoint, same process, same fresh payloads, same decode and DSpark settings; no historical speed is added to the measured gain.

provenance.timing_scope: Portable release qualification; background Hub upload and other host workload were active. Timings are retained as run evidence, not headline benchmark replacements.
